topic: What does one single day in India look like, in numbers?

hook.text: What does one single day in India look like, in numbers?

lines.say: Let's start at midnight. India registered two point five two crore births in twenty twenty-three.
lines.cap: India registered 2.52 CRORE births in 2023

lines.say: Wait, so that's about sixty nine thousand babies every single day?
lines.cap: Wait, that's about 69,000 babies EVERY DAY?

lines.text: Every single day of the year

lines.say: Roughly forty eight a minute, old chap. By the time your chai cools, a small classroom has arrived.
lines.cap: About 48 every MINUTE. One chai later, a small CLASSROOM has arrived.

lines.say: The number is easing, though. Twenty twenty-three had about two point three lakh fewer births than twenty twenty-two.
lines.cap: Easing: 2023 had about 2.3 LAKH fewer births than 2022

lines.say: Still a full house, I'm afraid. Just a slightly calmer one.
lines.cap: Still a FULL HOUSE. Just a slightly calmer one.

lines.say: Enjoying our little day trip? A quick like really helps a small channel like ours. Thank you!
lines.cap: Enjoying the trip? A quick LIKE really helps a small channel. Thank you!

lines.say: Breakfast first. India produced two hundred and forty seven point nine million tonnes of milk in twenty twenty-four, twenty-five. The world's largest.
lines.cap: 247.9 MILLION tonnes of milk in 2024-25. The world's LARGEST.

lines.say: That's nearly sixty eight crore kilos of milk. Every single day!
lines.cap: That's nearly 68 CRORE kg of milk. Every single DAY!

lines.say: Per person, four hundred and eighty five grams a day, up from four hundred and sixty eight. Two generous glasses each. Splendid.
lines.cap: 485 g per person per day, up from 468 g. Two generous GLASSES each.

lines.say: Then the eggs. One hundred and forty nine billion of them in the same year.
lines.cap: Then the EGGS: 149.1 BILLION in 2024-25

lines.say: So about forty one crore eggs a day. India is an omelette nation!
lines.cap: About 41 CRORE eggs a day. OMELETTE nation!

lines.say: And the grain, old chap. A record three hundred and fifty seven point seven million tonnes of foodgrain in twenty twenty-four, twenty-five.
lines.cap: A RECORD 357.7 million tonnes of foodgrain in 2024-25

visual.title: Foodgrain · 2024-25
visual.subtitle: million tonnes · Agriculture Ministry final estimates

lines.say: That's about ninety eight crore kilos of grain, every day, from India's farms.
lines.cap: About 98 CRORE kg of grain, EVERY DAY

lines.say: And output grew eight percent in just one year. Big respect to every farmer out there!
lines.cap: Output up 8% in ONE year. Big respect to every FARMER!

lines.text: Rice and wheat: both all-time records

chapters.title: A country that never stays home

lines.say: Commute time! Indian Railways carried seven hundred and forty one crore passengers in twenty twenty-five, twenty-six.
lines.cap: Indian Railways: 741 CRORE passengers in FY 2025-26

lines.say: Which is about two crore people a day, old chap, on roughly twenty five thousand trains.
lines.cap: About 2 CRORE people a day, on roughly 25,000 TRAINS

lines.say: Up in the sky, domestic flights carried about one thousand six hundred and seventy seven lakh passengers that year.
lines.cap: Domestic flights: about 1,677 LAKH passengers in FY 2025-26

lines.say: That's around four point six lakh flyers a day. So trains carry over forty times more people!
lines.cap: About 4.6 LAKH flyers a day. Trains carry over 40x MORE!

lines.say: And the roads? A record two point nine seven crore new vehicles were sold in twenty twenty-five, twenty-six.
lines.cap: A RECORD 2.97 crore new vehicles sold in FY 2025-26

lines.say: That's about eighty one thousand vehicles a day, or fifty six every minute.
lines.cap: About 81,000 vehicles a day. 56 every MINUTE.

lines.say: And most have two wheels! About fifty nine thousand scooters and bikes a day, versus thirteen thousand cars.
lines.cap: About 59,000 TWO-WHEELERS a day vs 13,000 CARS

lines.say: Seventy two percent of everything sold had two wheels. Hold on to your helmets, everyone.
lines.cap: 72% of all vehicles sold had TWO wheels. Hold on to your HELMETS.

lines.say: Now, money. In October twenty twenty-six, India made twenty five point four seven billion UPI payments.
lines.cap: October 2026: 25.47 BILLION UPI payments

lines.say: That's eighty two crore payments a day! Over nine thousand five hundred every second!
lines.cap: 82 CRORE payments a day! 9,500+ every SECOND!

lines.say: And the value, old chap. One lakh one thousand seven hundred crore rupees a day. A first.
lines.cap: ₹1,01,707 CRORE a day. The FIRST time above ₹1 lakh crore.

visual.label: average UPI value per day, October 2026

lines.say: That works out to about one point one eight crore rupees moving every second.
lines.cap: About ₹1.18 CRORE moving every SECOND

lines.say: And October beat September by five point eight percent. Festive shopping, everyone!
lines.cap: October beat September by 5.8%. FESTIVE shopping!

lines.say: My verdict: cash isn't gone, old chap. But it is certainly on a very long holiday.
lines.cap: Verdict: cash isn't gone. But it's on a very long HOLIDAY.

lines.say: On the twenty first of May, twenty twenty-six, India's power demand hit an all-time high of two hundred and seventy point eight gigawatts.
lines.cap: 21 May 2026: peak power demand hit an ALL-TIME HIGH of 270.8 GW

lines.say: In twenty thirteen, fourteen, the peak was just one hundred and thirty five point nine. It's almost doubled!
lines.cap: In 2013-14 the peak was just 135.9 GW. Almost DOUBLED!

lines.say: And capacity went from two hundred and forty nine gigawatts to five hundred and fifty two. A splendidly busy decade.
lines.cap: Capacity: 249 GW to 552 GW. A splendidly BUSY decade.

lines.say: Power shortages? Down to just zero point zero three percent, from four point two percent in twenty thirteen, fourteen.
lines.cap: Energy shortage: just 0.03%, down from 4.2% in 2013-14

lines.say: Per person, Indians used one thousand four hundred and sixty units of electricity in twenty twenty-four, twenty-five.
lines.cap: Per person: 1,460 UNITS of electricity in 2024-25

lines.say: Which is about four units a day each. A fan, some lights, the fridge, and that phone charger, I suppose.
lines.cap: About 4 UNITS a day each. A fan, some lights, the fridge, the CHARGER.

lines.say: And now more than half of India's power capacity is non-fossil: solar, wind, hydro and nuclear.
lines.cap: Over HALF of power capacity is now non-fossil

lines.say: Finally, our phones! Indians used two lakh eighty five thousand petabytes of mobile data in twenty twenty-five, twenty-six.
lines.cap: 2,85,376 PETABYTES of mobile data in FY 2025-26!

lines.say: Up nearly twenty five percent in a single year. Somebody is watching a great many reels.
lines.cap: Up nearly 25% in ONE year. Someone's watching a lot of REELS.

lines.say: Per user, that's twenty five point five gigabytes a month, up from twenty one point five a year earlier.
lines.cap: Per user: 25.5 GB a MONTH, up from 21.5 GB

lines.say: That's about eight hundred and seventy megabytes a day, each. Nearly a whole movie, every day!
lines.cap: About 870 MB a day, EACH. Nearly a whole MOVIE!

lines.say: And it keeps getting cheaper. Operators earned about eight rupees per gigabyte, down from nearly nine.
lines.cap: Cheaper too: about ₹8 per GB, down from ₹8.97

lines.say: So in one Indian day: sixty nine thousand births, two crore train trips, and eighty two crore UPI payments.
lines.cap: ONE DAY: 69,000 births, 2 CRORE train trips, 82 CRORE UPI payments

lines.say: Plus sixty eight crore kilos of milk and forty one crore eggs. What a day!
lines.cap: Plus 68 CRORE kg of milk and 41 CRORE eggs. What a DAY!

lines.say: Which number surprised you most today? Do tell us in the comments, old chap.
lines.cap: Which number SURPRISED you most? Tell us in the comments!

lines.say: Thank you for spending these minutes with us. If you learned something, please like it, share it with a friend who loves numbers, and subscribe for next week's deep dive.
lines.cap: Thank you! LIKE, SHARE with a numbers-loving friend, and SUBSCRIBE for next week

title: One Day in India in Numbers: Births, Milk, Trains, UPI & Power 🇮🇳
description:
What does one single day in India look like? The panel follows a full 24 hours through official data: births, breakfast, commutes, money, electricity and mobile data.

The standouts: about 69,000 births registered every day (2023), about 2 crore train journeys a day, and 82 crore UPI payments a day in October 2026, worth over ₹1 lakh crore. Peak power demand has almost doubled since 2013-14.

Which of these numbers surprised you most? Tell us in the comments.
